# linearctl config

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl config set

```
Change a setting. Keys: default-team.
default-team is the team --team falls back to after LINEARCTL_TEAM.
Changes things: pass --dry-run to preview, --yes to apply.

Usage:
  linearctl config set KEY VALUE [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl config set default-team ENG --yes

Flags:
      --dry-run   show what would change; change nothing
  -h, --help      help for set
      --yes       apply the change
```

## linearctl config show

```
Show the settings and the file they live in

Usage:
  linearctl config show [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl config show --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for show
```
